title: docs(spec): put the `forceCbpMasterDetailRequired` "only the security gate" sentence in the past tense
body:
Fixes #24291
Clause-②: no

## What changes

This PR rewrites one sentence in the `forceCbpMasterDetailRequired` docblock and adds a prose-only `patch` changeset. Nothing else changes. The sentence is in the "Why" paragraph of `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, now `:3483`–`:3490`.

Before:

> Today only the security gate (`assertControlledByParentWrite`) closes that shape, and commit 75b7c240a records that the declaration and the enforcement disagree. This makes the unsafe shape impossible to NEWLY declare:

After:

> Before commit 75b7c240a only the security gate (`assertControlledByParentWrite`) closed that shape, by refusing the insert at runtime, and that commit records that the declaration and the enforcement disagreed. Since protocol 18 the parse refuses the declaration itself: {@link refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster} refuses a `controlled_by_parent` object none of whose `master_detail` fields declares `required: true`. The builder makes the unsafe shape impossible to NEWLY declare:

- "This makes" became "The builder makes". The sentence before it is now about the parse, so "This" would point at the wrong mechanism.
- `.changeset/24291-cbp-docblock-tense.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, prose only, with `Clause-②: no`.

No key, schema, export, accepted value or message text changes. All 12 changed lines in `packages/spec` are ` *` comment lines.

## What each claim rests on

**The past half: before commit 75b7c240a, only the security gate closed that shape, by refusing the insert.**

- Commit `75b7c240a3eb` (read through the REST API) adds the builder force and this docblock. Its changeset says: "#8772 measured that only the security gate closed that shape while the declaration surface accepted it." So the old "Today" meant the tree before that commit, and "records" stays true.
- I read `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` at `75b7c240a` through the contents API. That commit does not touch this file, so its parent has the same content.
  - `resolveCbpRelation` picks a required `master_detail`, then any `master_detail` (`:4949`), then a required `lookup`.
  - A non-required master resolves with `omissionRefusedByValidation` false (`:4969`).
  - The insert leg takes the master id from the body (`:5164`). A null id throws `MasterReferenceMissingError` (`:5251`), because the stand-down at `:5250` does not apply.
  - The record validator never checks a field that is not `required` (PR #24290's contract review, D7). So at runtime, the gate's insert refusal was the only one.

**The present half: since protocol 18, the parse refuses the declaration itself.**

- `refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster` (`object.zod.ts:2213`) runs inside `ObjectSchemaBase`'s `.superRefine` (`:3143`, called at `:3167`).
- It reports the verdict of `controlledByParentMasterRefusal` (`src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts`). That function counts a field as a master only when `type === 'master_detail'` and `required === true`, and refuses unless exactly one field counts.
- It is a protocol 18 change: the parse refusal is registered by `src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.cbp-master-relation-tiers-retired.ts`.
- I ran a one-off probe against the built `dist/data/index.mjs`. No test file was added or kept. Each object below declares `sharingModel: 'controlled_by_parent'`:

| `master_detail` fields | `ObjectSchema.safeParse` | `ObjectSchema.create` |
|---|---|---|
| one, `required` omitted | refused at `["sharingModel"]`, "but no required `master_detail` field" | passes (forced) |
| one, `required: false` | refused at `["sharingModel"]` | throws (the force's refusal) |
| one, `required: true` | passes | passes |
| one required, plus one with `required` omitted | passes | throws at `["fields"]` (two required after the force) |

The fourth row is why the new sentence states the exact predicate ("none of whose `master_detail` fields declares `required: true`"). It does not say "a `master_detail` without `required: true`", which would be wrong for that row.

**Which door the sentence claims.** It claims only the `ObjectSchema` parse. That means `.parse()`, `.safeParse()` and `create()`, which runs the force (`:3677`) and then `ObjectSchemaBase.parse(withDefaults)` (`:3687`).

The sentence says nothing about `defineStack`, `os validate`, the metadata save door or stored rows. The refinement's own docblock says stored rows still register, under a `[metadata_spec_invalid]` diagnostic. I did not read those doors for this PR, so the sentence does not name them.

The sentence also drops "only", and it does not say whether the gate still closes the shape. I read what the gate does today: it derives a master from exactly one required `master_detail` (`security-plugin.ts:7923`), and on any write to an object without one it throws `MasterDetailRelationMissingError` (`:8585`). That is not this sentence's subject, so the sentence makes no claim about it.

**The symbol reference.** The new text cites the symbol as `{@link refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster}`. That is the form the same docblock already uses one paragraph below the list. It is not a `path#symbol` anchor, so `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` does not judge it. That gate counts `12 symbol (12 declaration, 0 literal)` on this head, the same as on PR #24290. The name has exactly one declaration in the file: `git grep -c "^function refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster("` gives 1.

## Changeset

`@objectstack/spec`'s `files` array ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the docblock goes into the tarball as written. It does not reach `dist`. After the build, 0 `dist` files carry the docblock's unchanged phrase "arms the worst measured failure shape", and 0 carry the new "closed that shape, by refusing the". The function's name is in `dist`, which is the positive control. So the published surface is the source file, and the changeset is a `patch` with `Clause-②: no`. This follows PR #24290 and PR #24072.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`. Nothing was regenerated.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 694 passed (694)`, `Tests 21040 passed | 1 todo (21041)`.

- The build, the tests and the typecheck ran on the pre-merge head `6abb5d815`. The merge brought no `packages/spec` change.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `5d9d774b1` derived 81 commands from 2 paths against merge base `21070a2f0`. 80 exit 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reads `81 derived, 80 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
  - `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`: `4972 anchors across 2121 spec sources resolve`.
  - `check:nul-bytes`: OK.
  - `check-adr-0087-registration`: `this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset`.
  - `check-empty-changeset`: green.
  - `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:lean-entry-closure` read built output. Both exit 0, after I built `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql`.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`** (exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`). It reads every workspace package's `dist`, and 69 package entries had none. I did not run a whole-repo build locally; that is a declared narrowing. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs this gate.

- `git grep "Today only the security gate" -- packages`: 0 hits on this head, 1 on the base `ef6564684`.
- No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour.
- Left to CI: `test:repo` (`Test Core`), `pnpm lint`, the type-check lanes, and the families outside the derived set.

## Acceptance notes

- **The same docblock, outside this card's file surface.** The paragraph after the list (`:3498`–`:3507`) says "so a raw parse of a `master_detail` without `required: true` is refused rather than forced". The probe's fourth row reads otherwise: next to a required `master_detail`, a second one without `required` parses green. (`create()` refuses that object, because the force makes both required.) Read as "the object's one `master_detail`", the sentence holds. This is an observation, not a defect. Carrier: none.
- **`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:304`, a code comment.** It says "the security gate's fallbacks stay, so metadata already at rest keeps loading and is still guarded". Since protocol 18, the gate has no fallback: `security-plugin.ts:7923`, and the gate's own docblock says both tiers retired. This is the same family, a comment that names a retired mechanism in the present tense. It is not published: `@objectstack/lint`'s `files` is `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. 0 `dist` files carry the phrase, while the neighbouring code string "readable by nobody" is in `dist`. Carrier: none.

## Deviations

- `main` was merged once before this PR opened (`5d9d774b1`), as AGENTS.md section 10 asks.
- I read commit `75b7c240a` twice through the REST API: the commit itself, and `security-plugin.ts` at that ref. Nothing was fetched into the shared object store.
- Labels: none written.
